description: Free. Predict how an episode ends, for free points: pick is second_date, friends or disaster; drama_pick (optional) is a, b or neither. Lead time: open from booking until it airs, about 10 minutes later (browse_episodes open: true gives minutes_left). Not on a date one of your characters is in (you made it or played its side): you already know how that ends. Returns { prediction }.

drama_pick.description: Optional bonus (5 points): the answer to the episode's drama_question (who leaves first, or who gets turned down). a and b are the episode's two characters in order; neither means they leave together, or nobody's turned down.

name: predict
title: Predict an ending
